source: maplestory.io (GMS 270) — skillbook API + raw WZ API
notes: Frames listed with placeholder=true are 1x1 timing placeholders in the source WZ data; the player skips them.

skills.name: Ravenous Gait
skills.description: Hunt your prey with the stealthy movement of an apex predator.

skills.name: Nature's Wrath
skills.description: Resonates with nature's fury to increase stats.

skills.name: Wild Arrow Blast: Proto
skills.description: [Crossbow Skill] Wield a crossbow to rapidly loose bolts that pierce the enemy.

skills.name: Jaguar Rider
skills.description: Climb aboard Ashlii's back, bolstering your strength with wild fury. Increases Speed and Knockback Resistance while riding Ashlii. Only movement skills can be used when not riding Ashlii.

skills.name: Savage Bound
skills.description: Leap once more while already in the air. Can be used twice. Press the Up Arrow key at the same to move upward.

skills.name: Savage Bound
skills.description: Increases Crossbow Attack Speed for a short time.

skills.name: Predator's Pounce
skills.description: Ashlii marks the closest enemy as her prey. Use the skill again to leap to their location. Afterward, Predator's Pounce: Footstool becomes usable to jump off of the target.\nHold the Down Arrow key and use the skill to mark a different enemy.\nPermanently increases Speed and Jump.

skills.name: Predator's Pounce
skills.description: Manage captured Jaguars. You can reach the Jaguar Habitat through Black Jack in the Secret Square. Your stats are increased by capturing special Jaguars. Snow White and Onyx Jaguar stats do not stack.

skills.name: Predator's Pounce: Footstool
skills.description: Leap again by stepping on the heads of prey. Only activates after teleporting with Predator's Pounce and is deactivated after use.\nShares SP with Predator's Pounce.

skills.name: Assist: Rending Swipe
skills.description: [Assist Skill] Upon landing a Crossbow skill, Ashlii's power of nature manifests as a Spirit Jaguar that slashes enemies with its claws.\nRending Swipe is unaffected by attack reflection. Assist skills are unaffected by cooldown reset effects.

skills.name: Final Attack
skills.description: Has a chance to trigger an additional hit when a direct attack Crossbow skill lands.

skills.name: Soul Arrow
skills.description: Allows you to use your crossbow without bolts and increases Attack Power.

skills.name: Agile Crossbows
skills.description: Increases Attack Speed and Dexterity.

skills.name: Crossbow Mastery
skills.description: Increases Crossbow Mastery and damage.

skills.name: Primal Edge
skills.description: Unleashes greater power through the primal instincts of a beast.

skills.name: Physical Training
skills.description: Permanently increases STR and DEX through sheer physical training.

skills.name: Wild Arrow Blast: Detonation
skills.description: [Crossbow Skill] Fire custom modified crossbow bolts that explode after traveling a set distance.

skills.name: Wild Arrow Blast: Detonation
skills.description: Attack multiple enemies by firing penetrating arrows equipped with bombs. Has a chance to Stun enemies.

skills.name: Call of the Wild
skills.description: Ashlii roars to enhance party combat power for a short time.

skills.name: Assist: Snapping Fangs
skills.description: [Assist Skill] The Spirit Jaguar sinks its fangs into the enemy. Activates after Assist: Rending Swipe.\nSnapping Fangs is unaffected by attack reflection. Assist skills are unaffected by cooldown reset effects.

skills.name: Another Bite
skills.description: Enemies attacked by the Spirit Jaguar become marked with primal fury. When a marked enemy is hit with a Crossbow skill, the enemy is struck by an additional attack.\nAnother Bite is unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Feral Resonance
skills.description: Resonate with the power of the wilds to become fiercer.

skills.name: Slinking Titan
skills.description: Conditioning in the wilds has made you stealthy and more resilient.

skills.name: Wild Arrow Blast: Shattershot
skills.description: [Crossbow Skill] Fire custom piercing bolts from your arsenal. Additionally, fires an explosive round at set intervals.\nThe explosive round is unaffected by attack reflection or cooldown reset effects.

skills.name: Wild Arrow Blast: Shattershot
skills.description: Quickly fires five consecutive arrows.

skills.name: White Heat Rush
skills.description:
Pounces to push away enemies and deal damage. Can be resisted by some enemies.
Use the skill to move upwards diagonally in the direction you are facing. Combine with the down arrow key to move downwards diagonally. Combine with the left or right arrow key to charge forward. You cannot charge forward while in the air.
If you aren't on Ashlii, it must be used with the Attack key to use skills. Using Action Customization allows you to use skills with just the skill key even when you aren't riding Ashlii.
Right-click to toggle Action Customization ON/OFF.

skills.name: White Heat Rush
skills.description: Summons a trap that attacks nearby enemies. The trap is so alluring that monsters attack it instead of you.

skills.name: Trap Seed
skills.description: Places a support unit that scatters mines. The mines explode when an enemy touches them. Previously set-up mines are retrieved each time new ones are deployed.\nTrap Seed is unaffected by attack reflection.\nUsing Trap Seed doesn't start combat, and if you don't enter combat for a set duration the unit will stop deploying mines.

skills.name: Trap Seed
skills.description: Summon a silver hawk that hovers around you, attacking and possibly Stunning monsters nearby.

skills.name: Wild Arrow Blast: Shattershot
skills.description: Cries out a feral roar to neutralize attacks inflicted on you. Not affected by effects which reset cooldown. In addition, Attack Power, Final Damage, Speed, Max Speed, Attack Speed, and Max HP are permanently increased.

skills.name: Feline Berserk
skills.description: Cries out a feral roar to neutralize attacks inflicted on you. Not affected by effects which reset cooldown.

skills.name: Backstep
skills.description: When activated, Ashlii can attack while moving backward without changing direction. Works even when you aren't riding Ashlii.\nCan be toggled On/Off.

skills.name: Assist: Skull Bash
skills.description: [Assist Skill] The Spirit Jaguar slams headfirst into the enemy. Activates after Assist: Snapping Fangs.\nSkull Bash is unaffected by attack reflection. Assist skills are unaffected by cooldown reset effects.

skills.name: Extended Magazine
skills.description: Attach a special Resistance magazine to your Crossbow to hold stronger bolts.

skills.name: Crossbow Expert
skills.description: Master the use of the crossbow.

skills.name: Advanced Final Attack
skills.description: Permanently increases Attack Power. Greatly increases the damage and activation rate of your Final Attacks.

skills.name: Wild Instinct
skills.description: Awakens your instincts to better spot enemy weak points.

skills.name: Wild Arrow Blast: Apex - Reinforce
skills.description: Increases the damage of Wild Arrow Blast: Apex.

skills.name: Wild Arrow Blast: Apex - Guardbreak
skills.description: Increases the Ignore Defense of Wild Arrow Blast: Apex.

skills.name: Wild Arrow Blast: Apex - Spread
skills.description: Increases the max number of enemies hit by Wild Arrow Blast: Apex.

skills.name: Assist - Reinforce
skills.description: Increases the damage of Assist Skills.

skills.name: Assist - Spread
skills.description: Increases the maximum number of enemies hit by Assist Skills.

skills.name: Assist - Boss Rush
skills.description: Increases Boss Damage of Assist Skills.

skills.name: Another Bite - Reinforce
skills.description: Increases the damage of Another Bite.

skills.name: Another Bite - Guardbreak
skills.description: Increases the Ignore Defense of Another Bite.

skills.name: Another Bite - Boss Rush
skills.description: Increase the Boss Damage of Another Bite.

skills.name: Wild Arrow Blast: Apex
skills.description: [Crossbow Skill] Upgrade your crossbow to rapidly loose bolts that pierce the enemy. Additionally, fires an explosive round at set intervals. This is a continuous channeled skill.\nThe explosive round is unaffected by attack reflection or cooldown reset effects.

skills.name: Command: Alpha Surge
skills.description: [Command Skill] Ashlii calls upon a pack of Spirit Jaguars to charge toward the enemy.\nCommand Skills can be used without an animation while using crossbow skills and are unaffected by cooldown reset effects.

skills.name: Lure Beacon
skills.description: Sets up a device that lures enemies, developed by the Resistance's special technology. Lure Beacon taunts enemies within a set range and prevents Wild Hunter from colliding with them for a period of time. Enemies that don't attack for a set duration after being taunted break free from the taunt.

skills.name: Sharp Eyes
skills.description: Temporarily grants party members the ability to locate an enemy's weak spot to deal critical damage to that enemy.

skills.name: Maple Warrior
skills.description: The Goddess of Maple World's grace increases your stats. Using the skill briefly makes the Goddess of Maple World appear.

skills.name: Hero's Will
skills.description: Hones your resolve to ignore certain abnormal status effects. Immune to most abnormal status effects for 3 sec. after use. Certain abnormal status effects will still get through. Does not apply Combat Orders.\nCan be used while using other skills.

skills.name: For Liberty
skills.description: Materializes the will of the Resistance to empower your attacks with the fight for freedom.

skills.name: Volt Snare
skills.description: Launches an electrified steel net to capture enemies.

skills.name: Command: Titan Pounce
skills.description: [Command Skill] A massive Spirit Jaguar pounces on the enemy. Prioritizes the boss with the highest Max HP within range.\nCommand skills can be used without an animation while using Crossbow skills and are unaffected by cooldown reset effects.

skills.name: Command: Predator's Eye
skills.description: [Command Skill] A predator's eyes focus on the prey, leaving a deep wound on the target. The focus prioritizes the boss with the highest Max HP.\nCommand skills can be used during crossbow skills without a casting animation and aren't affected by cooldown resets.\nInversion Effect On/Off: Right-click

skills.name: Wild Arrow Blast: Overdrive
skills.description: [Crossbow Skill] Hold the skill key to fire off the best crossbow Resistance tech can offer. Upon hitting an enemy with this skill, the crossbow unleashes an extra explosion. You are immune to knockback and debilitating abnormal statuses while casting this skill.

skills.name: Primal Bloom
skills.description: Release a blast of nature power in complete resonance with Ashlii. The blast rejuvenates the wild terrain with primal energy.\nColor and Wild Terrain Effect On/Off: Right-click

skills.name: Primal Bloom
skills.description: Release a blast of nature power in complete resonance with Ashlii. The blast rejuvenates the wild terrain with primal energy.

skills.name: Overbite
skills.description: Roar with the wild rage accumulated by Another Bite. The skill is used automatically when a boss reaches a certain number of Another Bite stacks. \nOverbite only triggers when used on a boss enemy that can be attacked.\nOverbite is unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Overbite
skills.description: Roar with the wild rage accumulated by Another Bite. The skill is used automatically when a boss reaches a certain number of Another Bite stacks. \nOverbite only triggers when used on a boss enemy that can be attacked.

skills.name: Synchronous Hunt
skills.description:
Enters into perfect harmony with Ashlii to make a coordinated assault.

Lv. 10 - Ignore Defense: +20%
Lv. 20 - Boss Damage: +20%
Lv. 30 - Ignore Defense: +30%, Boss Damage: +30%

skills.name: Gear Storm
skills.description:
Summons a large ballista built with the Resistance's cutting-edge engineering, which obliterates every enemy on the battlefield.

Lv. 10 - Ignore Defense: +10%, Boss Damage: +10%
Lv. 20 - Ignore Defense: +10%, Boss Damage: +10%
Lv. 30 - Ignore Defense: +20%
